_comment: Screenshots of the GoCommerce trade portal, taken on 26 October 2026 from a local GoCommerce 1.2 install with a made-up demo dealer, "Shree Electricals (demo)", and a sample electrical catalogue. Files in public/assets/portal/: <key>.webp at 1440 px wide, <key>-mobile.webp at 390 px wide, both at 2x for the phone.

overview.title: The dealer’s home screen
overview.caption: A dealer’s owner signs in and sees their payment terms, the amount still available to spend, what they owe, recent orders and a staff order waiting for approval.
overview.alt: The trade portal overview for a demo dealer: pay within 30 days, approval limit, available to spend of a limit, owed, overdue, three recent orders on account and one order waiting for approval

quick-order.title: Quick order
quick-order.caption: Product codes and quantities typed or pasted from a spreadsheet, ready to go into the basket at the dealer’s own prices.
quick-order.alt: The quick order screen with four product codes and quantities entered and an Add to basket button

statements.title: The statement
statements.caption: What the dealer owed at the start of the month, each order on account with its PO number and due date, and how much is late.
statements.alt: A statement for a demo dealer: owed at the start, ordered on account, paid, owed at the end, amounts by days late, and three orders with PO numbers and due dates
